name: Around the Corner
source:
As a kid everything can be scary at night. A coat draped over a chair, the wind hollowing outside, that odd shadow staring at you.
Oh, that wasn't there before? It's probably just a trick of the light. Mom did remember to plug in the nightlight, right?

[From [url=https://gewi-studios.itch.io/around-the-corner]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一个孩子，晚上一切都会很可怕。一件外套搭在椅子上，外面风很大，那个奇怪的影子盯着你。
哦，以前没有吗？这可能只是光的把戏。妈妈记得插上小夜灯吧？

[来自[url=https://gewi-studios.itch.io/around-the-corner]Itch.io[/url]]
